title: Arrangement Identifier
description: Interactive p5.js MicroSim in which learners read ten schematic side views of centrifugal fans, identify the drive, the impeller position and what carries the bearings, and then name the arrangement (1, 2, 3, 3SI, 3DI, 4, 7, 8, 9 or 10). Feature and arrangement answers are scored separately.
creator: Twin City Fan
subject: Fan arrangement
Direct drive
Belt drive
Shaft coupling
Overhung impeller
Center hung impeller
Bearing pedestal
Inlet box

educational.audience: Adult professional development: new application engineers, sales staff, representatives and facilities staff
learningObjectives: The learner will distinguish centrifugal fan Arrangements 1, 2, 3, 3SI, 3DI, 4, 7, 8, 9 and 10 from schematic side-view drawings by identifying the drive type, the impeller position relative to the bearings, and what carries the bearings and the motor.
standards: AMCA arrangement standard (drive arrangements for centrifugal fans)

accessibility.notes: describe() text (fallback mode); verdicts announced through FP.announce (aria-live); ✓/✗ glyphs, solid/dashed outlines and bold outlined highlights pair with colour; Tab and arrow keys reach every control, Enter checks or goes to the next drawing. Below 610 px wide the controls wrap and the canvas grows taller than 740 px.

controls.label: Check features
controls.purpose: Commit and check the three feature answers (Enter)

controls.label: Next drawing / See results
controls.purpose: Go to the next drawing or the results (Enter)

controls.label: Start over
controls.purpose: New shuffled round; resets both scores

rules: Ten drawings in shuffled order, one attempt per question per drawing.
The arrangement question unlocks after the three features are checked; feature answers are scored but do not block it.
When all three committed features are correct, the arrangements consistent with them are highlighted; otherwise none are.
Mastery is 8 of 10 arrangements correct on the first attempt; features are scored separately out of 30.
assumptions: Schematics are simplified teaching drawings, viewed from the side of the shaft.
limitations: Not manufacturer outline drawings; Arrangement 2 is not shown in FanPedia.

sources: FanPedia pp. 20-23 (arrangement drawings and captions), p. 30 (impeller orientation), pp. 162-168 (technical descriptions)
Arrangement 2: AMCA arrangement standard definition as stated in Chapter 11

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Feature decomposition before classification: learners commit three feature answers, then name the arrangement, with immediate corrective feedback.
keyQuestions: How is this fan driven: belts, a coupling, or the impeller on the motor shaft?
Is the impeller overhung or between the bearings?
What carries the bearings and the motor?
commonMisconceptions: Every direct drive fan is Arrangement 4.
Any fan with a coupling is Arrangement 7, whatever the impeller position.
Arrangements 1 and 9 differ in impeller position (they differ only in motor location).
Arrangements 2 and 1 are the same (Arrangement 2's bearings are on a bracket carried by the housing).
assessmentOpportunities: First-attempt score shown as 'Arrangements correct: n of 10'; mastery is 8 of 10 on the first attempt.
'Features correct: n of 30', scored separately as scaffolding.
Results screen lists each drawing's arrangement, the learner's choice and features correct.
